sub_issue: 1a) same driver in several cars in one race
findings: 83 (season, round, driver_id) groups, sizes {2: 77, 3: 6}. Every group has a different car number per row (distinct car numbers per group: {2: 77, 3: 6}). Constructors per group: {1: 69, 2: 13, 3: 1}. (season, round, driver_id, driver_number) is unique across all 25873 rows: True.
proposed_policy: Keep every row in interim as a separate CAR ENTRY with entry key (season, round, driver_id, driver_number). Never deduplicate. In the model dataset (one row per driver per race) use the driver's PRIMARY entry = best official position; add n_entries and multi_entry_driver flag. Derived season points must SUM all entries (points are split between shared drives).
consequence_for_ml_dataset: 40 early races get one model row per driver instead of 2-3; no information is lost because secondary entries stay in interim. Affects only 1950-1964, far from validation (2022) and test (2023-2025). Blueprint key (race_id, driver_id) stays valid for model rows.

sub_issue: 1b) several drivers credited with one car's position
findings: 105 (season, round, position) groups with 2+ drivers; 105 of them share the SAME car number and constructor (co-drivers of one car). Shared wins (position 1): 3 races. Shared podium positions: 20 groups. 113 of these rows are also 1a duplicate-driver rows (same car-swap practice).
proposed_policy: Keep all co-driver rows. Flag shared_car_result on every row whose (race, position) is shared. Each co-driver keeps the official position (so two drivers can both be P1 in 3 races). Race-level evaluation that assumes exactly one winner must skip races with a shared win.
consequence_for_ml_dataset: 'Exactly one winner per race' (blueprint 12.1) holds for all races from 1965; the 3 shared-win races are excluded only from race-level winner metrics, not from training rows.

sub_issue: 2a) seasons before 1994
findings: No qualifying records at all for 1950-1993 (44 seasons).
proposed_policy: qualifying_position and times = missing; race-level qualifying_available = 0. Do not drop races. Grid (always present) remains the main starting-order feature.
consequence_for_ml_dataset: Any model using qualifying features must handle 100% missingness before 1994 (median/grid imputation inside the pipeline + indicator), or those features are restricted to the E9 modern training windows.

sub_issue: 2b) partial seasons 1994-2002
proposed_policy: Represent as missing + two indicators: race-level qualifying_available (race has any qualifying data) and row-level has_qualifying_row. Never drop these races. Do not impute across drivers from other races.
consequence_for_ml_dataset: Prevents silently losing 83 races; the indicator lets models learn that missingness is an era artefact, not a driver property. Qualifying-gap features (gap to pole) must be NaN, not 0.

sub_issue: 2c) drivers without a qualifying row in races that have qualifying
findings: 26 result rows (statuses {'+1 Lap': 7, 'Finished': 5, '+2 Laps': 3, 'Power Unit': 2, 'Brakes': 2}).
proposed_policy: Row-level has_qualifying_row = 0; qualifying_position missing (grid still available).
consequence_for_ml_dataset: Small; handled by the same missing-value rule.

sub_issue: 3a) grid 0 on non-starters and ambiguous rows
findings: 202 of 267 grid-0 rows are did_not_start or ambiguous. By era and category: {'1950-1969': {'classified_not_running': 0, 'did_not_start': 143, 'disqualified': 0, 'finished': 0, 'started_not_classified': 0}, '1970-1989': {'classified_not_running': 0, 'did_not_start': 38, 'disqualified': 9, 'finished': 0, 'started_not_classified': 1}, '1990-2009': {'classified_not_running': 0, 'did_not_start': 14, 'disqualified': 4, 'finished': 0, 'started_not_classified': 2}, '2010-2025': {'classified_not_running': 4, 'did_not_start': 7, 'disqualified': 0, 'finished': 36, 'started_not_classified': 9}}.
proposed_policy: grid 0 on a non-starter means 'no starting position'. These rows are excluded from model rows anyway (issue 5), so no recoding is needed.
consequence_for_ml_dataset: None for model rows; this explains why grid 0 is common before 1970 (143 rows, all non-starters).

sub_issue: 3b) grid 0 with laps > 0 (started): pit-lane start
findings: 48 rows, eras {'2010-2025': 48}; categories {'finished': 36, 'started_not_classified': 8, 'classified_not_running': 4}.
proposed_policy: Interpret as PIT-LANE START (data-driven rule: started and completed laps, not era-based). Later (Step 8/11): grid_position = field_size + 1 and pit_lane_start = 1; keep original grid.
consequence_for_ml_dataset: Matches blueprint 13.2 for the modern era. The rule needs no era threshold because no pre-2010 grid-0 row completed a lap.

sub_issue: 3c) grid 0, started category, 0 laps
findings: 17 rows, eras {'1970-1989': 10, '1990-2009': 6, '2010-2025': 1}, categories {'disqualified': 13, 'started_not_classified': 4}.
proposed_policy: Treat grid as UNKNOWN (missing) + flag grid_unknown. Do not assume pit-lane start.
consequence_for_ml_dataset: Tiny; mostly disqualified/excluded entries that never completed a lap.

sub_issue: a) started and finished: finished
findings: 31 distinct statuses, top {'Finished': 8004, '+1 Lap': 3849, '+2 Laps': 1592, '+3 Laps': 730, '+4 Laps': 404, 'Lapped': 297}.
proposed_policy: Keep original status and positionText unchanged; add proposed_category (later).
consequence_for_ml_dataset: Model row; position target = official position; DNF = 0.

sub_issue: b) started, did not finish (classified): classified_not_running
findings: 57 distinct statuses, top {'Engine': 138, 'Out of fuel': 79, 'Accident': 71, 'Collision': 44, 'Spun off': 41, 'Gearbox': 35}.
proposed_policy: Keep original status and positionText unchanged; add proposed_category (later).
consequence_for_ml_dataset: Model row; keeps official classified position and points; proposed DNF = 0 (blueprint), flag retired_while_classified = 1.

sub_issue: b) started, did not finish (not classified): started_not_classified
findings: 109 distinct statuses, top {'Engine': 1855, 'Accident': 947, 'Collision': 785, 'Gearbox': 763, 'Spun off': 750, 'Suspension': 406}.
proposed_policy: Keep original status and positionText unchanged; add proposed_category (later).
consequence_for_ml_dataset: Model row (driver started); position target = official position (ordered by laps, issue 7); proposed DNF = 1.

sub_issue: c) disqualified: disqualified
findings: 3 distinct statuses, top {'Disqualified': 153, 'Excluded': 8, 'Underweight': 1}.
proposed_policy: Keep original status and positionText unchanged; add proposed_category (later).
consequence_for_ml_dataset: Model row (driver started); official position is at the back; DNF = 0, is_dsq = 1; excluded from DNF-model training only (blueprint 14).

sub_issue: d) did not start: did_not_start
findings: 33 distinct statuses, top {'Withdrew': 223, 'Accident': 29, 'Engine': 18, 'Did not start': 9, 'Injury': 8, 'Gearbox': 7}.
proposed_policy: Keep original status and positionText unchanged; add proposed_category (later).
consequence_for_ml_dataset: NOT a model row (never started; known at prediction time). Kept in interim; not counted as a start in history features.

sub_issue: e) ambiguous: ambiguous_withdrawn_after_start
findings: 1 distinct statuses, top {'Withdrew': 20}.
proposed_policy: Keep original status and positionText unchanged; add proposed_category (later).
consequence_for_ml_dataset: Proposed: model row as started_not_classified (it completed laps); needs approval. All are early-era rows.

sub_issue: e) ambiguous: ambiguous_classified_withdrawn
findings: 1 distinct statuses, top {'Withdrew': 3}.
proposed_policy: Keep original status and positionText unchanged; add proposed_category (later).
consequence_for_ml_dataset: Proposed: model row as classified_not_running; needs approval.

sub_issue: e) ambiguous: ambiguous_classified_not_classified
findings: 1 distinct statuses, top {'Not classified': 1}.
proposed_policy: Keep original status and positionText unchanged; add proposed_category (later).
consequence_for_ml_dataset: Proposed: model row as classified_not_running; needs approval.

sub_issue: summary: status alone is not a category
findings: 136 race statuses; 78 of them occur in more than one proposed category (e.g. Engine: R, W and numeric).
proposed_policy: Category = f(positionText, status, laps) as in propose_result_category(); full mapping in historical_status_category_proposal.csv.
consequence_for_ml_dataset: DNF target (optional) should use the category, not the status text; proposed DNF = started_not_classified only (blueprint 14: positionText R/N), with classified_not_running kept as a separate flag. Needs approval.

sub_issue: 5a) in season driver list, never participated
findings: 142 driver-seasons (128 drivers); 62 of them never have a race result in any season.
proposed_policy: Not model rows. Keep drivers.csv unchanged (it is the API's season list, not a participation list).
consequence_for_ml_dataset: No rows are created; driver counts must come from results, not from drivers.csv.

sub_issue: 5b) failed to qualify (qualifying row, no result row)
findings: Observable only where qualifying exists (1994+): 7 rows. Before 1994, DNQ entries have NO record at all (they are invisible; part of the 793 'absent_between_appearances').
proposed_policy: Not model rows (never started). Do not invent rows for invisible DNQs.
consequence_for_ml_dataset: The model population is 'starters', so DNQs are correctly absent; field_size counts starters only.

sub_issue: 5c) started the race (result row, started category)
findings: 25511 rows: {'finished': 15554, 'started_not_classified': 9121, 'classified_not_running': 674, 'disqualified': 162}.
proposed_policy: THESE are the model rows (after the Indianapolis 500 exclusion, issue 8).
consequence_for_ml_dataset: Model population before other exclusions: 25511 rows (+24 ambiguous rows if approved).

sub_issue: 5d) non-starters that have a result row
findings: 338 rows with category did_not_start (positionText W, 0 laps); grid 0 on 202, grid > 0 on 136.
proposed_policy: Not model rows; keep in interim; the filter uses the category (positionText/status/laps), NOT grid.
consequence_for_ml_dataset: Removes about 1.3% of result rows from the model population; they are known before the race (withdrawn/DNS) so excluding them is not leakage.

sub_issue: 6a) one ID = one name
findings: 203 constructor IDs and 203 names; strict 1:1 mapping: True. The API never renames an ID; a rename appears as a NEW ID (e.g. alphatauri -> rb).
proposed_policy: Use API constructor_id as the historical identity; keep constructor_name as a separate label. Never merge IDs by name similarity.
consequence_for_ml_dataset: Constructor history features restart when a team is renamed (e.g. rb in 2024).

sub_issue: 6b) brand IDs reused after long gaps
findings: 20 IDs have a gap of 5+ seasons, e.g. aston_martin 1959-2025 (gap 61), mercedes 1954-2025 (gap 55), honda 1964-2008 (gap 38), alfa 1950-2023 (gap 34), renault 1977-2020 (gap 17), ats 1963-1984 (gap 15). One ID can cover unrelated organisations (e.g. mercedes 1954-55 and 2010-25).
proposed_policy: Keep the ID. Build constructor features from RECENT windows (last 5/10/20 races, previous season) so a decades-old block has no effect; do not use all-time expanding constructor averages.
consequence_for_ml_dataset: Avoids 1950s Mercedes results influencing 2010s Mercedes features.

sub_issue: 6c) renames cannot be detected automatically
findings: 28 'ID ends, new ID starts next season with a shared driver' candidates, mixing real renames and driver moves: alphatauri->rb (2024), bar->super_aguri (2006), caterham->manor (2015), dallara->sauber (1993), eurobrun->jordan (1991), force_india->racing_point (2019), honda->brawn (2009), jaguar->red_bull (2005), jordan->mf1 (2006), jordan->spyker_mf1 (2006), ligier->prost (1997), lotus_f1->haas (2016), ...
proposed_policy: Do not infer lineage automatically. Optional (blueprint COULD): a small MANUAL, documented lineage table for modern teams only, as a separate column constructor_lineage_id.
consequence_for_ml_dataset: Without lineage, renamed teams lose form history for their first races under the new ID (affects a few 2019-2024 rows near the validation/test period).

sub_issue: 7a) non-classified (R) rows ordered by laps completed
findings: 1123 races have R rows; 7998 adjacent R pairs; only 8 inversions in 8 races (seasons [1951, 1968, 1971, 1981, 1983, 1989, 1991, 1992]); none after 2009.
proposed_policy: Accept the official numeric position as a meaningful order for ALL started rows (it follows laps completed in >99.8% of pairs). Keep the exceptions flagged; do not re-sort.
consequence_for_ml_dataset: Supports blueprint 14: position regression target covers non-finishers too.

sub_issue: 7b) R row placed above a classified row
proposed_policy: Flag; do not change. Inspect during Step 7 validation.
consequence_for_ml_dataset: Negligible.

sub_issue: 8a) exclusion rule
findings: race_name == 'Indianapolis 500' selects exactly 11 races (1950-1960) and 405 rows (107 drivers). circuit_id 'indianapolis' is ALSO used by 8 races: ['United States Grand Prix'] 2000-2007. Race names containing 'Indianapolis': ['Indianapolis 500']. Drivers who also raced other GPs: ['ascari', 'ruby', 'ruttman', 'ward'].
proposed_policy: Exclude rows where race_name == 'Indianapolis 500' (exact match) from model rows AND from driver/constructor/circuit history. Never filter by circuit_id. Keep the rows in interim.
consequence_for_ml_dataset: Removes 405 rows / 11 races; the US GP 2000-2007 stays. Season race counts used for round-based features must be recomputed without these rounds.
